ablation: control: context_fn = lambda obs: None (cue withheld; K10 confound control) — confirms the lift is cue-caused, not adapter-caused
baseline: frozen gains (same CueIndexedArbitrator class, frozen=True, pinned 1.0)
env: k12_cue_battery timing=episodic (cue drawn per episode, constant for 40 steps)
gate: CUE-CAUSED LIFT iff main_wins >= 3/4 (R >= 1.30 per seed) AND control_wins <= 1/4. ADAPTER-CAUSED (not cue-caused) iff main_wins >= 3/4 AND control_wins >= 3/4. BOUND STANDS iff main_wins <= 1/4. Exactly 2/4 main = INCONCLUSIVE (needs more seeds).
hypothesis: Cue-caused lift: total samples per cue (~240) unchanged from canonical; clustering within episodes does not starve the per-cue vectors.
note: preregistration sealed BEFORE the driver was written/run (K10 confound rule adopted)
null_hypothesis: Main fails -> cue-indexing needs within-episode cue alternation (e.g. the None-context mechanics break); record NR.
preregistered_metric: R = total(learned)/total(frozen) per seed, separately for main and control probes
protocol: K10 protocol: 12 episodes x 40 steps, channels a0/a1, neutral specialists, capacity=2, gain_lr=0.15, theta=0.45, ORIGINAL delta rule (baseline 0.5), CueIndexedArbitrator. Frozen = same class, frozen=True, gains pinned 1.0. Main probe: context_fn = obs.get('cue') (cue in input; None when hidden).
title: K12 cue-structure battery — episodic cue (constant within episode)
